1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive __epoxy__ binder; and a solvent.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an __electronic component surface or other surfaces requiring thermal management__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __or other surfaces__.

9. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising cavity-generating particles, a thermally conductive binder, and a carrier wherein the particle to binder ratio being about 1 gram to __0.5-1.0__ grams and the carrier being about 10 ml per gram of particles.

11. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the binder is __a thermally conductive premixed solder paste__.

12. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass, __and their alloys__.

13. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are __5-50 μm__ in size.

14. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are __10-50 μm__ in size.

15. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are __50-200 μm__ in size. 

16. (Currently Amended) A composition of matter comprising carrier, binder, and cavity generating particles, wherein said composition of matter contains, in relative proportion: about 10 ml carrier; about 0.5 to 1.0 grams binder; and about 1 gram of cavity generating particles.
